compiled_state.description:
## Context

Found while proving `peckish-marmatite-cuckoo` (`db2c-3a4b-1826-451f`) AC5, which requires
that deleting each `monkeypatch.setattr` on a resolver name makes its test FAIL.

Two of the 5 patch-site modules do not satisfy that oracle, and **the weakness predates
db2c**. Measured on `38f8587f65d` with the patches still targeting the shim
(`rebar._engine_support.resolver`), deleting the patch leaves the test green:

- `tests/unit/test_attach_commits.py:409` —
  `monkeypatch.setattr(resolver, "build_resolver_scan_index", lambda _tracker: None)`,
  test `test_referencing_commits_falls_back_to_per_call_scan_without_index`.
  Deleting it: `1 passed`.
- `tests/unit/test_completion_sidecar_material_balding.py:227-230` —
  the `resolve_ticket_dir_name` patch, test
  `test_legacy_payloads_without_material_still_round_trip`. Deleting it: `1 passed`.

The patches are **not inert** — both stubs are reached by production. Proven by wrapping
each stub in a recorder that writes a marker file when called; the marker was written for
all 7 patch lines across the 5 modules. The stub runs; the assertion simply does not
discriminate between the stubbed branch and the real one.

For `test_attach_commits.py:409` the docstring states the intent exactly: forcing the
index to `None` "restores the pre-index scanning path with identical crediting". The test
then asserts only that the target SHA is credited — true on both paths. So the test proves
crediting works, but does **not** prove the fallback path was taken.

## Change

Make each test fail when its patch is removed, without weakening what it asserts today.

1. `test_referencing_commits_falls_back_to_per_call_scan_without_index` — assert the
   fallback path was actually taken, not merely that the result matches. Record whether
   `build_resolver_scan_index` returned an index and assert the per-call scan ran
   (e.g. count `resolve_ticket_id` invocations, which differ between the indexed and
   per-call paths).
2. `test_legacy_payloads_without_material_still_round_trip` — assert the stubbed
   directory name is the one used, so a real `resolve_ticket_dir_name` produces a
   different and failing result.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1** For `tests/unit/test_attach_commits.py`, deleting the single
      `monkeypatch.setattr(..., "build_resolver_scan_index", ...)` line in a scratch copy
      makes `test_referencing_commits_falls_back_to_per_call_scan_without_index` FAIL.
      The failure assertion is recorded in a ticket comment.
- [ ] **AC2** For `tests/unit/test_completion_sidecar_material_balding.py`, deleting the
      single `monkeypatch.setattr("rebar._ids.resolve_ticket_dir_name", ...)` statement in
      a scratch copy makes `test_legacy_payloads_without_material_still_round_trip` FAIL.
      The failure assertion is recorded in a ticket comment.
- [ ] **AC3** Both tests pass unmutated:
      `pytest tests/unit/test_attach_commits.py tests/unit/test_completion_sidecar_material_balding.py -q`
      exits 0.
- [ ] **AC4** No assertion present before this change is deleted; `git diff` shows no
      removed `assert` line in either file.
- [ ] **AC5** `ruff check src tests scripts` exits 0 and `make typecheck` exits 0.
- [ ] **AC6** `git diff --name-only origin/main...HEAD` lists exactly 2 paths:
      `tests/unit/test_attach_commits.py` and
      `tests/unit/test_completion_sidecar_material_balding.py`.
- [ ] **AC7** `make verify` exits 0.

## Out of scope — checked, not merely unexamined

- **The other 5 patch lines** (`test_close_precheck_duplicate_link_c8fd.py:56`,
  `test_replacement_walker.py:55`, `test_close_duration_instrumentation.py:258,259,464`).
  All 5 already fail on deletion; measured, not assumed.
- **The resolver shim migration.** Independent: these 2 tests are weak against both the
  shim and `rebar._ids`.
compiled_state.title: Two resolver patch-site tests pass with their patch deleted
